text:
Maya Chen: FYI - Arkentis says they haven't received our invoice; procurement insists on an internal PO and vendor tax form before payment. They DM'd support, escalated to finance. Account ID: acct_ark_0042. Can ops/finance advise next steps?
Luis Ortega: Thanks Maya. Do we have the quote/invoice in a hold state or was it never issued?
Maya Chen: We generated an invoice but Finance marked it 'on hold' pending PO. Invoice #: INV-2026-0918. Arkentis needs the invoice to match their PO number and vendor registry entry.
Jordan (Support): Attached the customer's message: "We cannot process payments until the vendor is validated and a PO is issued internally. Please re-issue invoice referencing PO when provided."
Sam Patel (Arkentis): Confirming — procurement requires our vendor code + VAT ID on the invoice. They also want a copy of the redwood W-9 equivalent and vendor questionnaire completed. No payment until that's matched. Apologies for the delay.
Priya Singh: Understood. Two questions: 1) Can Finance issue a pro-forma or draft invoice that Arkentis can use to create their PO? 2) Can we add a placeholder PO field to the invoice PDF once they give the PO number?
Luis Ortega: Finance, tagging you here. @Finance Bot / @LuisFinance (cc Priya) — can you confirm process for reissuing invoice with PO and attaching tax docs?
Finance Bot: Auto-note: Please include invoice ID and account ID in request. Manual review required for vendor documentation. SLA: 2 business days for documentation validation.
Maya Chen: I have the docs Arkentis sent: VAT ID: GB999888777, vendor questionnaire (pdf). They also asked for our supplier code to be entered into their system.
Aria Rao (Arkentis Procurement): Quick clarification — we need a seller tax form (EU VAT or US W-9 as applicable) and a pro-forma showing expected total. If you can provide a draft invoice without payment terms we can create PO immediately.
Priya Singh: We can create a pro-forma draft. Two options: (A) Issue pro-forma/invoice now with "Pending PO: <placeholder>" and re-issue final invoice when they provide PO; (B) Provide a formal quote document they can use to create PO. Which is preferred by procurement?
Aria Rao (Arkentis Procurement): Draft invoice with "Pending PO" is fine; procurement team will create PO referencing your draft and then send PO number. We need the VAT ID and your official company registration info on the doc.
Luis Ortega: Finance: can you generate pro-forma with vendor registration info and include a line for "PO: to be added"? Also attach our W-9 + vendor registration PDF.
Finance Bot: Received. Workflow created: Ticket FIN-8272. Pending manual approval from Revenue Ops. Expected completion by 1779990018.
Maya Chen: If revenue ops needs any sign-off from Sales for credit terms, @Priya — can you confirm Net30 acceptance?
Priya Singh: Sales OK with Net30 for Arkentis. No special discounts.
Luis Ortega: Two minor gotchas: 1) If Arkentis is in EU, VAT handling differs — need to ensure reverse charge or VAT present. 2) If they insist on vendor code, we'll provide our supplier ID but procurement may still delay.
Sam Patel (Arkentis): We'll aim to create PO same day we get draft. Procurement said they'll only accept docs with our internal requester name (Sam P.) and department code 45-B. Can you include a small "Attention" line?
Maya Chen: I'll pass that to Finance to include "Attention: Sam P., Dept 45-B" on the draft.
Finance Bot: Draft pro-forma created: DRAFT-PF-INV-2026-0918. Includes company reg number, VAT ID, W-9 attached. Waiting final review.
Luis Ortega: If review clears, can we have Ops temporarily un-hold the original invoice so that we don't create duplicate records? Prefer to mark original as superseded by final invoice after PO is added.
Finance Bot: Best practice: mark original as "Superseded - awaiting PO" and keep DRAFT as pro-forma. Do not issue final invoice until PO matched.
Priya Singh: One fallback: if Arkentis needs immediate access/test of the service and can't wait for PO, we can accept a card payment for the first month and then convert to invoice billing once PO arrives. Does Arkentis want that?
Sam Patel (Arkentis): Card payment not allowed by our procurement policy for purchases > $10k. We need PO path.
Maya Chen: OK — timeline: Finance draft due by 1779990018, procurement to send PO hopefully same day, final invoice reissued with PO. I'll follow up.
Luis Ortega: Thanks all. Finance — please update FIN ticket with status and set reminder for 48h.
Finance Bot: FIN-8272 updated. Status: Draft ready for review. Reminder set for +48h.
Priya Singh: Noted. I'll check back with Arkentis midday.
Sam Patel (Arkentis): Appreciate the quick response. I'll ping once PO is created.
Maya Chen: Closing loop here once invoice issued. :white_check_mark:
